item.name: Money Boost
item.effect: Increases the pet's earning rate by 1.2x.
item.bestUse: Best on high-BPS pets that stay in your pen for steady cash generation.

item.name: Hatch Speed
item.effect: Increases egg hatch speed by 25% when the pet is placed in the pen.
item.bestUse: Useful on pets kept near egg production because it reduces waiting time between hatch cycles.

item.name: Breed Luck
item.effect: Increases breeding luck by 25%, improving hatch quality.
item.bestUse: Strong on breeder pets when you are trying to improve egg outcomes over repeated cycles.

item.name: Mutation Luck
item.effect: Increases the chance of a bred egg hatching into a mutated pet by 20%.
item.bestUse: Best when your goal is mutation hunting through breeding rather than immediate cash income.

item.name: Twin Eggs
item.effect: Gives a high chance to produce two eggs instead of one after each breed cycle.
item.bestUse: Pairs well with breeder pets because more egg output gives more chances at useful hatch results.

item.name: Rideable
item.effect: Allows the player to mount and ride the pet across the map.
item.bestUse: Best on a pet you actually keep and move with, especially when crossing islands or returning to your pen.
